title: How the Internet & SaaS DLP policies troubleshooting runbook routes a case: feature enablement, fine-tuning, web DLP triage and notification issues
aliases: Internet & SaaS DLP Policies Support Troubleshooting Runbook

prose.label: Where the sections go.
prose.text: Policy fine-tuning is in [[zia.dlp.runbook.fine-tuning]]. The web DLP triage order, log fields and rule criteria are in [[zia.dlp.runbook.web-dlp-triage]]. Email and ICAP notification checks are in [[zia.dlp.runbook.notifications]].

runbook-sections.statement: The DLP runbook has headings for DLP feature configuration assistance or policy fine-tuning, a web DLP policy (Inline DLP, OCR, EDM, and IDM) not working as expected, and a web DLP email or ICAP notification issue.

quotes: # Require DLP Feature Configuration Assistance or DLP Policy Fine-Tuning
# Web DLP Policy (Inline DLP, OCR, EDM, and IDM) Not Working as Expected
# Web DLP Email or ICAP Notification Issue

enablement-examples.statement: The runbook's examples of DLP features that need a license or enablement: the Files tab correlated view requires a license for SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP and a configured DLP scan; SaaS Security API Data at Rest Scanning DLP policy rules without content inspection are enabled by contacting Zscaler Support; new predefined DLP engines are available by default for tenants enabled on April 4, 2025, or later, with existing tenants contacting Zscaler Support.

quotes: Support for Correlated View of App Users and DLP File Access: To view the information on the Files tab, you must have a license for SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP, and you must configure the DLP scan.
Support for SaaS Security API Data at Rest Scanning DLP Policy Rules without Content Inspection: To enable this feature for your organization, contact Zscaler Support.
New Predefined DLP Engines: These engines are available by default for users with tenants enabled on April 4, 2025, or later. For enablement on existing tenants, contact Zscaler Support.

enablement-routes.statement: For a DLP feature that is not available, the runbook routes to the Zscaler Account team when the feature might require an additional subscription or SKU, and to Zscaler Support, with a Provisioning support case giving the feature details and the Help Portal or Release Notes reference link, when the feature is not enabled automatically for all users.

quotes: Contact your Zscaler Account team: The feature might require an additional subscription or an additional SKU, depending on your current Zscaler’s subscription.

Contact Zscaler Support: The feature is not enabled automatically for all users. Raise a Provisioning support case with Zscaler Support with the feature details and reference link from Zscaler’s Help Portal or Release Notes.

support-data-checklist.statement: The runbook's data checklist for a web DLP support case: HTTP Header HAR file, a packet capture (the Packet Capture option for Zscaler Client Connector, or the Wireshark capture method without it), Web Insights logs with all fields selected, the violation content notification email or JSON file, sample test data, and temporarily enabled Remote Assistance; highly sensitive data can be removed or obfuscated while it is still able to trigger the DLP issue.

quotes: For Zscaler Client Connector, use the Packet Capture option.
Without Zscaler Client Connector, use the Wireshark capture method.
Violation content notification email or JSON file.
You can remove or obfuscate the highly sensitive data while it is still able to trigger the DLP issue.
Sample test data. (You can skip this if the same data was provided earlier.)
3. Web Insights logs with all fields selected.
